To get people to collaborate on using an app that is just for sharing music sounds dumb when we could just hit the share button if we find a song. reviews.title: fell off after airbuds star service
reviews.text: i’ve been on airbuds for nearly three years now, having joined in mid 2023. for all that time, i’ve loved it. being able to see stats like how many minutes i listen to music each week, what tracks im repeating, and seeing what i have in common with my friends are all great qualities that the app provides. however, recently i have had zero interest in using airbuds. ever since they added in airbuds star, the whole app is plagued with constant requests for me to pay, and constant reminders of the features i’m missing out on for not paying. i understand money is needed to keep the app running, but it just feels so demanding that it’s significantly lowered my enjoyment of the app. on top of this, i feel irritated at the prioritization of gaining new users over maintaining enjoyment for older users. i’ve invited all of my friends to the app, and have at least four “credits” saved up on the unlock features page, and i’m sure the same goes for plenty of other people who have been using the app since its early days. however, none of the new features from the airbuds star subscription are exchangeable with credits, which i feel is unfair to those who have been waiting to be able to do more with that credit. overall, the app just feels like another cash grab music stats app, and no longer the fun social app it used to be. a good app at its core, but not one i have any interest in continuing to use.

reviews.title: Great app but PLEASE cut back on asking for money
reviews.text: Airbuds is (or atleast was) an amazing app, and it was refreshing to see such a new idea worked on by people who truly care. However, as of the recent update there has been a severe drop in quality. The once simplistic screen is cluttered with premium features and ads, trying to get people to pay for things they once had for free. I understand the Airbuds team needs some way to profit from the app, but if this continues users are going to start leaving. It’s such a great way to socialize with friends and it has been wonderful watching the app evolve over the past year, and I really don’t want this app to become insignificant due to it being polluted with ads and in app purchases. Please listen to your fans! I’m writing this because I care.

reviews.title: Unusable if you use Apple Music
reviews.text: Do not download this app if you use Apple Music! It is absolutely impossible to get songs to synch to your listening history. I’ve tried all of the troubleshooting and none of it works. If you queue up songs, download songs, skip them a second too early, or even look at them the wrong way, they refuse to show up. It’s not user error—it’s Airbuds refusing to connect to Apple Music. It’s genuinely disappointing because this app has such a cool concept and cool features. Unfortunately, this app is miserable to use as an Apple Music player. There are just soo many glitches when it comes to Apple Music. Terrible app for Apple Music users.

I’ve been waiting the past few weeks for the bug to be fixed but am now close to deleting it as it no longer serves any benefit.

reviews.title: Support Team Does NOT Help - Apple Music Bug
reviews.text: I explained to support team that every time one of my alarms (from Apple’s built-in clock app) goes off, the song shows up on my AirBuds. It’s a hassle to manually delete it from my history when I have MULTIPLE alarms every single day. They replied with generic copy-pasted tips that had nothing to do with what I explained. So, I explained it AGAIN and even told them I’d love if they could add a BLOCK SONG feature so that I wouldn’t have to manually delete my alarm songs every day multiple times a day. However, it’s been 2 full weeks and they haven’t replied since. Extremely unhelpful and irritating. Just add a block song button PLEASE.
